findings.name: Drill-through "Filter by this value" (=) on a summarized value returns "No results!"
findings.summary: A filter pill "Sum of Total is equal to 1265.7162964063327" is added and the result becomes "No results!" (Showing 0 rows). The row that was clicked disappears. The same happens for March 2026: filter "Sum of Total is equal to 14115.657943115426" → No results, 0 rows. Only some values work (April 2025, "equal to 52.75594257942132", returns its 1 row), so the filter matches on the raw float instead of the value shown/returned by the aggregate. (on /question (notebook question, result table))
findings.expected: The query is filtered to rows where Sum of Total equals the clicked value, so the clicked row (May 2025 = 1,265.72) is still shown — 1 row, as happens for the April 2025 row (52.76).
findings.actual: A filter pill "Sum of Total is equal to 1265.7162964063327" is added and the result becomes "No results!" (Showing 0 rows). The row that was clicked disappears. The same happens for March 2026: filter "Sum of Total is equal to 14115.657943115426" → No results, 0 rows. Only some values work (April 2025, "equal to 52.75594257942132", returns its 1 row), so the filter matches on the raw float instead of the value shown/returned by the aggregate.
reproSteps: Sign in and open /question/notebook
Pick Sample Database → Orders, Summarize: Sum of Total grouped by Created At: Month, click Visualize
Switch to the table view (data icon next to the chart icon at the bottom)
Click the Sum of Total value cell of the May 2025 row (1,265.72) — the drill-through menu opens
In 'Filter by this value' click '='
Repeat with the March 2026 row (14,115.66)

findings.name: Text filter "Contains %" returns all rows instead of none: LIKE wildcards are not escaped
findings.summary: The filter is accepted and returns the whole table: \"Showing first 2,000 rows\" out of 2,500, with unrelated names (Hudson Borer, Domenica Williamson, ...). The % is passed to SQL LIKE as a wildcard instead of a literal character, so the filter silently does not filter. Reloading the page keeps the same unfiltered result. (on /question/notebook)
findings.expected: No person's name contains the literal character "%", so the filter \"Name contains %\" should return 0 rows (\"No results!\").
findings.actual: The filter is accepted and returns the whole table: \"Showing first 2,000 rows\" out of 2,500, with unrelated names (Hudson Borer, Domenica Williamson, ...). The % is passed to SQL LIKE as a wildcard instead of a literal character, so the filter silently does not filter. Reloading the page keeps the same unfiltered result.
reproSteps: Sign in and open /question/notebook, then choose Sample Database > People
In the Filter block click "Add filters to narrow your answer", pick the Name column
Change the operator to "Contains" and type a single percent sign % into the value box
Click "Update filter" (or "Add filter") and look at the row count

findings.name: Ctrl+Enter in an empty SQL editor runs an empty query and shows an SQL error instead of doing nothing
findings.summary: The app sends an empty query and shows the error panel 'An error occurred in your query — Only SELECT statements are allowed in a native query.' with 'Showing 0 rows'. The URL hash of the question confirms the query it sent is empty ('"native":""'), while the button next to the editor stays disabled. A person who has not typed anything is told there is a SQL problem in a query they never wrote. (on /question (New → SQL query))
findings.expected: Nothing runs, because the editor is empty: the Run button is disabled and Save is disabled, so the keyboard shortcut should be a no-op or say that a query is needed.
findings.actual: The app sends an empty query and shows the error panel 'An error occurred in your query — Only SELECT statements are allowed in a native query.' with 'Showing 0 rows'. The URL hash of the question confirms the query it sent is empty ('"native":""'), while the button next to the editor stays disabled. A person who has not typed anything is told there is a SQL problem in a query they never wrote.
reproSteps: Sign in as eval@momentic.ai and click New → SQL query (Sample Database is preselected; the editor shows only the grey placeholder 'SELECT * FROM TABLE_NAME').
Type nothing at all.
Press Ctrl+Enter (the same shortcut the editor advertises as 'Run query (Ctrl+enter)').

findings.name: Collection picker in the Save dialog overflows sideways on a phone, hiding the collection list and the action buttons
findings.summary: The picker keeps its desktop pane layout wider than the phone screen: the left collection list is clipped to its last characters, row text is cut mid-word, and the bottom buttons ('New collectio', 'Select this collection' off-screen) can only be reached by scrolling the dialog horizontally, so a collection cannot be chosen with a normal phone use. (on /question/notebook (Save new question → "Where do you want to save this?"))
findings.expected: On a 390px screen the picker should fit the modal: the collections list readable, the panes stacked or collapsed, and the Cancel / Select this collection buttons fully visible without horizontal scrolling.
findings.actual: The picker keeps its desktop pane layout wider than the phone screen: the left collection list is clipped to its last characters, row text is cut mid-word, and the bottom buttons ('New collectio', 'Select this collection' off-screen) can only be reached by scrolling the dialog horizontally, so a collection cannot be chosen with a normal phone use.
reproSteps: Sign in as eval@momentic.ai, set the browser to a phone size 390×844.
Open /question/notebook, open Sample Database, choose the Orders table, then click Save (top right) to open the 'Save new question' dialog.
Click the location button 'Harbor Admin's Personal Collection' to open the 'Select a collection or dashboard' picker.
Look at the Recents tab: the rows are clipped ('Harbor Admin's P...' with 'in O...' cut at the right edge).

Switch to the Browse tab: the collection list is pushed off the left edge so only the tail 'gent8-sub' is visible, and the bottom buttons 'New dashboard' / 'New collection' are cut off; 'Select this collection' and the three panes are not reachable without scrolling the dialog sideways.

findings.name: Second statement in a native SQL query is silently ignored with no message
findings.summary: The result shows only the value of the first statement (a scalar "1", status 'Showing 1 row') and nothing indicates that the second statement was not run. No error, no warning, no note: a person who pastes a two-statement script is given the first result as if it were the whole answer. (on /question (native SQL editor))
findings.expected: Either the second statement is executed (two result sets) or the app tells the person that only the first statement was run / that multiple statements are not supported.
findings.actual: The result shows only the value of the first statement (a scalar "1", status 'Showing 1 row') and nothing indicates that the second statement was not run. No error, no warning, no note: a person who pastes a two-statement script is given the first result as if it were the whole answer.
reproSteps: Sign in as eval@momentic.ai, click New → SQL query (Sample Database is preselected).
In the SQL editor type exactly: SELECT 1; SELECT 2;
Press Ctrl+Enter (or click the round Run button).

findings.name: SQL error box shows Metabase's internal query header (userID, queryHash) to the user
findings.summary: The error panel shows the raw database text including the internal header Metabase prepends to native queries: 'Syntax error in SQL statement "-- Metabase:: userID: 1 queryType: native queryHash: 6ff0fec3ca35952e7b6f7e9b92c0c402648ac4aa112dd38bbb2d4314867c6eb7\u0000aSELECT id, total FROM orders WHERE id = {{my min}}[*]" [42000-214]'. The person sees an internal tracking comment, an internal hash and their numeric user ID instead of a readable message about the unrecognised variable. (on /question (native SQL editor))
findings.expected: A human-readable error (for example that "{{my min}}" is not a valid variable name / that the variable must be defined), without the internal '-- Metabase:: userID ... queryHash ...' line and without the raw internal hash in the UI.
findings.actual: The error panel shows the raw database text including the internal header Metabase prepends to native queries: 'Syntax error in SQL statement "-- Metabase:: userID: 1 queryType: native queryHash: 6ff0fec3ca35952e7b6f7e9b92c0c402648ac4aa112dd38bbb2d4314867c6eb7\u0000aSELECT id, total FROM orders WHERE id = {{my min}}[*]" [42000-214]'. The person sees an internal tracking comment, an internal hash and their numeric user ID instead of a readable message about the unrecognised variable.
reproSteps: Sign in as eval@momentic.ai, click New → SQL query.
In the SQL editor type: SELECT id, total FROM orders WHERE id = {{my min}} (a variable name containing a space).
Press Ctrl+Enter and read the error box.

findings.name: Row limit silently accepts 0 and -1 and then ignores them, with no message
findings.summary: The field keeps 0 (or -1) with no error message, but nothing is applied: after Visualize the results are unlimited ('Showing first 2,000 rows') and the header stays the plain saved title with no Save button, i.e. the value was not even registered as an unsaved change; reopening Row limit in Editor shows the field empty again. Seen with 0 and with -1, both times the value was silently dropped. (on /question/notebook)
findings.expected: The Row limit field should refuse a limit that cannot mean anything (0 or a negative number) with a message next to the field, or apply it, so the results agree with the number shown in the notebook.
findings.actual: The field keeps 0 (or -1) with no error message, but nothing is applied: after Visualize the results are unlimited ('Showing first 2,000 rows') and the header stays the plain saved title with no Save button, i.e. the value was not even registered as an unsaved change; reopening Row limit in Editor shows the field empty again. Seen with 0 and with -1, both times the value was silently dropped.
reproSteps: Sign in as eval@momentic.ai / momentic-eval-1 and open a saved question built on Sample Database → Orders, e.g. /question/43 (agent9-dup-q1).
Click Editor to open the notebook, then click the Row limit button.
Type 0 into the 'Enter a limit' field and press Enter (repeat the whole check with -1).
Click Visualize.

findings.name: A custom column may be named exactly like an existing table column, so the results table and the column pickers show two identical \"Total\" columns
findings.summary: The name 'Total' is accepted silently and the column picker (and the results table) list two columns with the identical label 'Total' — the Orders.Total column and the computed [Quantity] * 2 — with nothing in the label, the icon, or a warning to say which is which. Picking one for a filter, sort or summarize can silently use the other column. (on /question/notebook)
findings.expected: A custom column that would collide with an existing column name should be refused or renamed (as happens between two custom columns, where 'agent4-net' becomes 'agent4-net (1)'), so that every column in the result and in the filter/sort/summarize pickers can be told apart.
findings.actual: The name 'Total' is accepted silently and the column picker (and the results table) list two columns with the identical label 'Total' — the Orders.Total column and the computed [Quantity] * 2 — with nothing in the label, the icon, or a warning to say which is which. Picking one for a filter, sort or summarize can silently use the other column.
reproSteps: Sign in with eval@momentic.ai / momentic-eval-1 and open /question/notebook
In 'Search for tables and more…' choose Sample Database → Orders

Click the 'Custom column' (+) icon under the Data step, type the expression [Quantity] * 2 and give it the name Total, then click Done (no warning is shown, although Total is already a column of Orders)
Click the 'Filter' button of the Data step to open the column picker and read the Orders list: 'Total' appears once among the base columns
Scroll the same list to the bottom (after 'Combined ID, User ID'): a second entry, also labelled 'Total', is the custom column
Compare with a duplicate among custom columns: naming a second custom column 'agent4-net' is automatically changed to 'agent4-net (1)'

findings.summary: At phone width the bottom-left control next to the gear icon is a blank light-grey rounded box: neither the "Visualization" label nor a visualization icon is visible, while at desktop width the same control reads "Visualization". The only visualization switch available is the small chart icon in the middle of the footer bar. (on /question (native SQL editor results footer))
findings.expected: The visualization-type button in the results footer keeps a visible label or icon at phone width, so a person can tell what it is.
findings.actual: At phone width the bottom-left control next to the gear icon is a blank light-grey rounded box: neither the "Visualization" label nor a visualization icon is visible, while at desktop width the same control reads "Visualization". The only visualization switch available is the small chart icon in the middle of the footer bar.

From the home page choose New → SQL query, keep Sample Database
Type SELECT * FROM ORDERS LIMIT 50 in the editor and press Ctrl + Enter so the results table appears
